RENTAL AGREEMENT (VERSION 2)

This Rental Agreement ("Agreement") is made on this 1st day of April 2026, by and between:
LANDLORD: Mr. Ramesh Sharma, residing at Indiranagar, Bengaluru.
TENANT: Mr. Ankit Kumar, residing at Bengaluru.

1. PREMISES & TERM
The Landlord agrees to rent Flat 302, Green Acres Apartment, Indiranagar, Bengaluru to the Tenant for a period of 11 months starting 1st April 2026.

2. RENT AND SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Monthly rent shall be Rs. 25,000 payable on or before the 5th of each month. The Tenant shall pay an interest-free Security Deposit of Rs. 1,50,000. The Security Deposit shall be returned to the Tenant within 30 days of vacating.

3. LOCK-IN PERIOD AND TERMINATION NOTICE
Either party may terminate this agreement after giving 30 days written notice to the other party.

4. SUBLETTING RESTRICTION
The Tenant shall not sublet, assign, or transfer the demised premises or any part thereof to any third party under any circumstances without prior written permission of the Landlord.
